seoTitle: Text Splitter by Characters, Words, Lines or Sentences
metaDescription: Cut long text into parts of a set number of characters, words, lines or sentences. Words are never split. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Cut a long text into parts of a set number of characters, words, lines or sentences, for example to fit a limit. Words are never cut in half.
why:
Long text often has to fit a limit: a form field, a message, a translation tool. Splitting by hand risks cutting a word in half.

Choose characters, words, lines or sentences and a size, and get numbered parts. In character mode a part ends at the last whole word that fits. For splitting with overlap for AI retrieval use the Text Chunk Splitter instead.
howTo: Choose the unit and the maximum size of a part.

faq.a: Only a single word longer than the limit is cut, because it cannot fit otherwise.
At a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark followed by a space. Abbreviations can cause extra breaks.

faq.q: Can I get overlap between parts?
faq.a: Not here. The Text Chunk Splitter adds overlap for retrieval use.
